scope: Independent read-only final H11 backend source and author-evidence review; no Cargo, browser, App, Agent, database or helper execution.

checks.name: frozen-source-and-evidence
checks.detail: All 21 path/hash references in the author receipt match current bytes, including six final source files. Final source checkpoint agrees. Final targeted stdout records 26 passed, 0 failed in 15.01s; clippy records finished. Zero fmt/clippy exit status is taken from the author receipt; these commands were not rerun.

checks.name: directory-replacement
checks.detail: Queued directories capture no-follow dev/inode identity, recheck before path enumeration and after closing its iterator, and discard that directory's candidates/new child queue on detected replacement; root is checked again. The preserved old-behavior seam has one real failed symlink-replacement assertion; the final identical guard test passes.

checks.name: bounded-name-enumeration
checks.detail: read_dir is consumed incrementally, with total and per-directory entry checks before next(); files, depth, discovered directories, returned UTF-8 path bytes and cooperative elapsed work are bounded. Only the bounded subset is sorted. Missing root rejects; subtree/name failures mark partial, fixed exclusions and limit reasons remain explicit. Literal backslash and unrepresentable names are never rewritten to a different path.

checks.name: exact-cancel-and-real-worker-lifetime
checks.detail: Exact UUID flags have bounded inactive retention; live registrations cannot be evicted. The whole Lease moves into the real blocking closure. Observer timeout/drop does not release that lease or the shared file-check/global activity permits. Actual dropped-observer and real 15-second readPending barrier tests keep the worker running, accept exact cancellation and release only after the worker barrier returns. A cancellation acknowledgement does not claim OS work stopped.

checks.name: selected-byte-identity-and-errors
checks.detail: Text reading walks root/relative no-follow handles, accepts regular files only, reads at most 256KiB+1, compares complete file stamps and reopens current root/path identities before returning strict UTF-8. Replacement, growth and symlink tests are in the final 26. All public backend failures carry fixed codes; scan UI uses fixed translations/fallback, and readBusy wording covers both request-registry capacity and file-check admission.

checks.name: real-wire-provenance
checks.detail: The two raw stdout lines occur verbatim in targeted-lifecycle-green.txt and parse to actual-wire.json exactly: three complete candidate paths and a truncated 2000-path subset of a 2005-file fixture. This review did not execute the frontend parser.

checks.name: preserved-failure-classification
checks.detail: Two valid original listing failures and the later directory replacement failure remain intact. Initial non-UTF8 fixture creation failure, ENOSPC before tests and enum lint failure are not counted as further product failures. Earlier checkpoint is not substituted for the final six-source checkpoint.

helperInputCrossCheck.note: An earlier message suspected a final-wire drift; direct byte/hash comparison disproved it. No old receipt was rewritten and no input-drift addendum is needed. Candidate helpers remain prepared, not executed.

boundaries: Candidate names are not a complete or atomic project snapshot. Enumeration is path-based with before/after no-follow identity checks; this is not protection against every instantaneous swap-and-restore race. Selected byte reads have a separate strict handle check.
5-second cooperative scanning and 15-second response observation do not guarantee a blocking OS call has ended. Cancellation is cooperative; no automatic retry or global cancellation was added.
UUID records expire after a bounded inactive period; callers must use fresh IDs. They are not a durable replay ledger.

These author tests ran on macOS. Windows and installed-product behavior remain separately unverified by this receipt. Frontend controlled-browser findings and installed testing have separate owners/evidence.
This review performed no production edits and no repeated test, build, installation, App, Agent or live-data operation.
